moments.author: Donald J. Trump
moments.quote: I said right from the beginning that he's no good, a TOTAL DISGRACE
moments.why: Trump’s attack on LeBron James over anthem behavior immediately ignited massive debate among sports and politics circles.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.quote: As crazy as this sounds, $1T in SpaceX revenue in 2028 is no longer impossible
moments.why: Bold financial forecast from Musk sparked intense chatter among tech, finance, and SpaceX enthusiasts.

moments.author: Brewster Kahle (via repost)
moments.quote: “Babe, wake up, the internet is collapsing” referencing two massive security flaws
moments.why: Security experts and laypeople alike shared panic over major web vulnerabilities via widely reposted warning.

moments.author: Tom Arnold
